system_prompt: You are a careful contract-analysis assistant. You are given part of a commercial contract and a clause type. Decide whether this text contains a clause of that type. If so, return the relevant passages copied VERBATIM from the text (do not paraphrase; keep each passage as short as possible while covering the provision). If there is no such clause, say so. Respond ONLY with JSON: {"found": true/false, "passages": ["..."]}

descriptions.Expiration Date: The date or condition on which the agreement expires or the initial term ends.
descriptions.Renewal Term: How long the agreement is renewed or extended for after the initial term.
descriptions.Notice Period To Terminate Renewal: How far in advance notice must be given to prevent renewal or terminate at the end of a term.
descriptions.Cap On Liability: Any cap or limit on a party's liability (for example a maximum amount or a time limit for claims).
descriptions.Ip Ownership Assignment: Provisions assigning or allocating ownership of intellectual property created under the agreement.
descriptions.Post-Termination Services: Obligations or services that continue or must be provided after termination or expiration.
